slides.title: Introduction to Autoencoders
slides.goal: Understand what an autoencoder is and its components.

slides.title: Encoder and Decoder
slides.goal: Learn how the encoder maps input data to the latent space, and how the decoder reconstructs data from this latent space.

slides.title: Why Probabilistic Latent Space?
slides.goal: Understand why making the latent space probabilistic is beneficial.

slides.title: KL Divergence
slides.goal: Learn about KL divergence and its role in VAEs.

slides.title: Reparameterization Trick
slides.goal: Understand the reparameterization trick and how it simplifies optimization.

slides.title: Derivation of ELBO
slides.goal: Carefully derive the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) in a VAE.

slides.title: Full VAE Loss and Architecture
slides.goal: Understand the full VAE loss function and its architecture.

slides.title: Summary
slides.goal: Summarize the key concepts of VAEs.
